argument_order_authority: Named official problem/example inputs; solve is a local canonical wrapper, not a claimed official API symbol.

domain.l,r: equal-length integer query arrays, length1..500; every0<=l[i]<r[i]<len(nums)

independent_oracle: Host sorts each slice and compares all successive differences; exhaustive permutations control small slices. Equal values are valid; duplicates invalidate only nonzero-step progressions.

local_effect_policy.authority: prospective local callable-interface policy, separate from official statement mutation silence
local_effect_policy.mutable_return: fresh structure; no aliases to any input

numeric_unicode_policy: Strict safe integer inputs/outputs; no bool-as-int, coercions, NaN/infinity or BigInt. Stated binary/a-b strings are ASCII. Positive-product oracle uses signs rather than overflow-prone products; modulo arithmetic intermediates remain below2^53.

official_evidence.kind: web-tool text extraction inspected, not raw HTML

result_comparison: ordered Boolean list; reject numeric truthiness
result_semantics: For each inclusive range, decide whether its values can be rearranged into a constant-difference sequence. Preserve query order.

source_complexity_review.claimed_bound: O(total queried length) expected time/O(longest query length) auxiliary space
source_complexity_review.review_method: static source-as-data control-flow/allocation review; runtime unexecuted

source_provenance.authorship_scope: Owner-published input implementations; upstream derivation/license not independently attested.
source_provenance.publication_license_status: not independently resolved by qualification preparation
